svg.aria-label: Chain of custody: a signed commit leads to an ed25519 signature verified by GitHub, to an immutable release tag, to a Zenodo DOI with an independent timestamp, to an ORCID bound to a person. Each link is independently checkable and none of them can be reassigned by copying a repository.

g.text: Five links. Each one checkable on its own. None of them transfers when a repository is copied.
authored and signed locally, never through a web editor
public key uploaded to GitHub, so the badge is checked by them and not claimed by me
a release, not a branch: the tree it points at cannot change under it
timestamped by CERN, resolvable forever, and not issued by me
a person, not an account: the DOIs list this iD and the iD lists the DOIs
This image is served from github.com/zaidwhy. Wherever you are reading it, it is loading from there.
PLATE 05 · ORIGINAL WORK OF ZAID ALI SYED · ORCID 0009-0003-4313-1510 · MMXXVI
